contract.callback_mutation_isolation: A listener can remove another listener during callback execution without aborting EventBus.emit()
contract.current_cycle_continuity: The listener removed during a callback still receives the current broadcast exactly once
contract.post_removal_continuity: Subsequent broadcasts remain operational after listener removal
contract.removed_listener_isolation: A listener removed during a callback receives no subsequent broadcasts
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid after callback-driven removal
contract.delivery_once: Registered listeners receive each applicable event exactly once
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
